name: Kilo App
desc: iOS and Android companion for following up on Kilo sessions.
desc_zh: 在 iOS 和 Android 上跟进 Kilo 会话的配套应用。
solves: Sessions only progress while you watch the editor; the phone shows what the agent is doing and lets you answer it.
solves_zh: 只有盯着编辑器会话才会推进；手机上能看清智能体在做什么，并直接回复它。
best_for: You are away from the desk and an agent is waiting on a decision from you.
best_for_zh: 人不在电脑前，而智能体正等着你拍一个板。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — blog.kilo.ai directory）。 Official name in the post body is Kilo App, described as a Kilo Code companion. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：形态枚举没有手机应用；账本里手机应用记为 web。 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.kilo.ai/p/kilo-app-for-ios-and-android-is-live
